info.name: BetMate API
info.description:
Run requests top to bottom in order. Two accounts are used: Challenger (sends bets) and Challengee (receives bets). Tokens and IDs are captured automatically — you never need to copy-paste anything.

Prerequisite before testing bets: seed a match via Prisma Studio (npx prisma studio) with status UPCOMING and scheduledAt at least 4 hours from now.

graphql.query: query { health }

item.name: 1. Setup Accounts
item.description: Run both requests in order. Challenger = the user who sends challenges. Challengee = the user who receives them. All tokens are saved automatically.

request.description: Creates the account that will send friend requests and bet challenges. Saves challengerToken and challengerId automatically.
Creates the account that receives friend requests and bet challenges. Saves challengeeToken and challengeeId automatically.

item.name: 2. Become Betmates
item.description: Challenger sends a friend request. Challengee accepts it. After this they can challenge each other on matches.

request.description: Runs as Challenger. Saves friendshipId automatically.
Runs as Challengee. Uses the friendshipId saved in the previous step.
Verify the Challengee appears in Challenger's betmates list.
Search for users by username or name. Blocked users are hidden. Returns friendship status alongside each result.

item.name: 3.Get a Match
item.description: Run Create Test Match first, then Get Upcoming Matches. The create request only works in local dev and is blocked in production.

request.description: Creates a test match scheduled 5 hours from now. Only works in local dev. Change hoursFromNow to any value above 2 to keep the challenge window open. Saves matchId, team1, team2 automatically.

exec: console.log('Match', action + ':', match.team1, 'vs', match.team2, '| id:', match.id);

request.description: Saves matchId, team1, and team2 automatically from the first result. These are used in all bet requests.

exec: pm.expect(json.data.matches.length).to.be.above(0, 'No upcoming matches found. Seed one via Prisma Studio first.');

item.name: 4. Bet Flow
item.description: The complete bet lifecycle from challenge to team lock. Run every request in this folder top to bottom without skipping any.

request.description: Challenger sends a bet challenge to Challengee on the saved match. Saves betId automatically.
Challengee checks their inbox. Should see the PENDING challenge from Challenger.
Challengee accepts. Status moves to ACCEPTED. Either user can now flip the coin.

exec: console.log('Challenge accepted! Either user can now flip the coin.');

request.description: Random 50/50 toss. Saves tossWinnerId and tossWinnerToken automatically. The next request (Pick Team) uses the winner's token without any manual steps.

exec: console.log('Pick Team will automatically run as the winner.');

request.description: Runs automatically as the toss winner (token set by Flip Coin). Picks team1 from the match. The other team is automatically assigned to the opponent. Status moves to TEAMS_LOCKED.
Shows you and all your Betmates ranked by total points. Both accounts will appear here at 0 points (no completed bets yet).

exec: console.log('#' + e.rank, e.user.username, e.points + 'pts', e.betsWon + 'W', e.betsLost + 'L');

request.description: Full history between Challenger and Challengee. myWins and theirWins only count COMPLETED bets so they will show 0 until a match finishes.

exec: console.log('vs', h.betmate.username, '| You:', h.myWins, 'W | Them:', h.theirWins, 'W | Net:', h.netPoints, 'pts');

item.name: 5. Error Cases
item.description: These verify the API rejects invalid actions. Each request expects a GraphQL error in the response. Tests go green when an error IS returned.

request.description: To test this properly: first run Send Challenge, then immediately run this without running Accept Challenge. Should return INVALID_STATUS error.

header.description: Change to challengeeToken if Challenger won the toss

request.description: After flipping the coin, check who LOST the toss from the Flip Coin response. Run this as the loser before T-2h. Should return NOT_TOSS_WINNER error.
Tries to challenge a user who is not a Betmate. Should return NOT_BETMATES error.

graphql.query: query MyBets { myBets { id } }

request.description: No Authorization header. Should return UNAUTHENTICATED error.
Use this INSTEAD of Accept Challenge to test the decline flow. Run Send Challenge first to get a fresh PENDING bet.

item.name: Auth Utilities
item.description: Standalone auth operations. These are not part of the main test flow.

graphql.query:
query Me {
  me {
    id
    email
    username
    firstName
    lastName
    points
    emailVerified
    isActive
    lastLogin
    createdAt
  }
}

request.description: Use this if your challengerToken expired. Replace the email with the Challenger's email from the signup response.
Use this if your challengeeToken expired. Replace the email with the Challengee's email from the signup response.
